in_arabic.name: جهانزبون

in_urdu.name: جہانزبون
in_urdu.long_meaning: جہانزبون کا نام دو حصوں سے مل کر بنا ہے، جهان اور زبون، جو دنیا کی زینت اور جمال کے معنی رکھتا ہے، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم ثقافت میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اسلامی روایت میں گہرا مذہبی اور ثقافتی معنی رکھتا ہے

in_pashto.name: جهانزبون

historical_references.context: Jahanzebun was a Turkish slave who was bought by Saladin (Salah al-Din Yusuf ibn Ayyub). He was a gifted soldier and rose through the ranks to become an important commander in Saladin's army. In 1226 CE, Jahanzebun led the defense of Kerak Castle against the Crusaders, eventually surrendering it in exchange for safe passage for the defenders.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abd al-Hakam's Al-Suluk: Volume 1, Page 181 The name Jahanzebun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Jahanzebun was a slave in the army of Nur ad-Din Muhammad ibn Zengi, the ruler of Mosul and Aleppo. He was a skilled warrior and was eventually emancipated by Nur ad-Din for his bravery in battle. Later, Jahanzebun became the governor of Damascus under Saladin's rule.
